mapper.insert: INSERT INTO notification ( category, title, message, target_type, target_id, created_at ) VALUES ( #{category}, #{title}, #{message}, #{targetType}, #{targetId}, NOW() )
mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT a.account_id FROM place_order po JOIN branch b ON po.branch_code = b.branch_code JOIN account a ON a.branch_code = b.branch_code WHERE po.po_no = #{poNo}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO notification_receiver ( notification_id, account_id, is_read, read_at ) VALUES ( #{notificationId}, #{accountId}, 0, NULL )
mapper.select: SELECT po.po_id AS poId, po.po_no AS poNo, po.branch_code AS branchCode, b.name AS branchName FROM place_order po JOIN branch b ON po.branch_code = b.branch_code WHERE po.po_no = #{poNo}
